title: Deep-merge config objects
summary: Layer environment overrides onto default config without mutating either, and without prototype pollution.
prompt: Config is built from layers: defaults, then an environment file, then flags. Write
type Json = string | number | boolean | null | Json[] | { [key: string]: Json };
function deepMerge(base: JsonObject, override: JsonObject): JsonObject
- Keys from `override` win. When **both** sides hold a plain object, merge them recursively.
- `null` in `override` is a real value: it clears the setting.
- Do not change `base` or `override`, and the result must not share objects with them:
editing the merged config later must not change the defaults.
- Skip the keys `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype` (the override may come from `JSON.parse` of
untrusted input). The result must stay an ordinary object.
deepMerge({ server: { host: "localhost", port: 8080 }, debug: false }, { server: { port: 9090 } })

template: {{CODE}}
Dojo.eq("nested objects merge", { server: { host: "localhost", port: 9090 }, debug: true },
deepMerge({ server: { host: "localhost", port: 8080 }, debug: false }, { server: { port: 9090 }, debug: true }));
Dojo.eq("deeper levels merge too", { db: { pool: { min: 1, max: 20 }, name: "app" } },
deepMerge({ db: { pool: { min: 1, max: 10 }, name: "app" } }, { db: { pool: { max: 20 } } }));
Dojo.eq("arrays are replaced, not concatenated", { hosts: ["c"] }, deepMerge({ hosts: ["a", "b"] }, { hosts: ["c"] }));
Dojo.eq("null clears a setting", { cache: null }, deepMerge({ cache: { ttl: 60 } }, { cache: null }));
Dojo.eq("an object can replace a scalar", { log: { level: "debug" } }, deepMerge({ log: "info" }, { log: { level: "debug" } }));
const base: JsonObject = { db: { pool: { max: 10 } }, tags: ["x"] };
const override: JsonObject = { db: { name: "app" } };
const before = JSON.stringify([base, override]);
const merged = deepMerge(base, override);
Dojo.eq("the inputs are unchanged", before, JSON.stringify([base, override]));
((merged.db as JsonObject).pool as JsonObject).max = 99;
(merged.tags as Json[]).push("y");
Dojo.eq("editing the result does not touch the defaults", '{"db":{"pool":{"max":10}},"tags":["x"]}', JSON.stringify(base));
const evil = JSON.parse('{"__proto__": {"admin": true}, "theme": "dark"}') as JsonObject;
const merged = deepMerge({ theme: "light" }, evil);
Dojo.eq("ordinary keys still merge", "dark", merged.theme);
Dojo.check("__proto__ is skipped: no inherited admin flag", Object.getPrototypeOf(merged) === Object.prototype && !("admin" in merged) && !("admin" in {}),
"the merged object picked up an 'admin' property through __proto__");

hints: Build a fresh object: copy every key of `base`, then every key of `override`, merging when both values are plain objects.
A plain object is `typeof v === "object" && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)`; everything else is copied as a whole.
Copy leaves with `structuredClone(value)` so the result shares nothing, and `continue` past `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype`.
